response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, `T-BIL` * 1.0 / NULLIF(CRE, 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14'), grouped AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM grouped) SELECT g.status, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio / o.overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL;
